summary: This Phase 3 clinical trial compares how different diabetes medications affect blood sugar levels in adults with type 2 diabetes. The study aims to look at blood glucose fluctuation, which means how much blood sugar levels go up and down. It is sponsored by Nanjing First Hospital, Nanjing Medical University and plans to include 50 participants. The current status of the study is Unknown status.

facts.sponsor: Nanjing First Hospital, Nanjing Medical University
